deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for inference-router v2.3.1 -> canary group 'alpha' (10%) | sha: a1b2c3d4 | change window: 2026-03-20
emma: watching metrics — will call if anything looks off
matt: seeing tail latency jump on canary node-3, p95 420ms -> 980ms vs baseline
sophia: which alert fired?
emma: end2end_latency.p95 (service=inference-router) crossed 600ms for 3m, error rate still ~0.2%
raj: suggest we pin traffic back to v2.3.0 and run the rollback corridor runbook. Better to be safe.
emma: +1. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/fallback-runway-rollback — follow steps 1-4 (cordon, unroute, pin, cleanup)
deploy-bot: Canary pause triggered automatically at threshold breach. Action required: `confirm rollback` to proceed.
matt: I’ll lead — starting step 1: cordon affected canary node(s).
matt: `infractl canary cordon inference-router --group alpha --nodes node-3`
sophia: I’ll unroute 90% of alpha -> stable. Keeping 10% for quick smoke. Logging actions to #eng-oncall.
emma: after unroute, watch KV cache warmup and p95. If stable, pin to 2.3.0 and note in release notes.
raj: executing pin now: `/deploy pin inference-router 2.3.0`
deploy-bot: Pin recorded: inference-router -> 2.3.0 by raj at 3832101200
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 — Canary latency spike; rollback exercised
matt: cordon + unroute done. p95 dropped to ~450ms within 2m.
sophia: running runbook step 4: remove canary artifacts from registry and revoke canary feature flags.
emma: draft release note: "Reverted v2.3.1 canary due to latency regression observed in alpha; rollback executed; RCA in progress."
raj: will open the postmortem ticket and move to #postmortems once we have logs :checkered_flag:
deploy-bot: Canary deployment aborted and traffic restored to v2.3.0.
emma: thanks team — leaving thread open until postmortem is linked.
